author: victorwelander
adaptations: Items carry an id and a NamedIcon name as DATA instead of a LucideIcon component, so DOM pages can pass plain JSON.
Added mode 'choice' (controlled value stays expanded, radiogroup) and mode 'action' (hovered or focused item expands, toolbar, press fires onSelect).
usehooks-ts useOnClickOutside replaced with one document pointerdown listener, active only while an action item is expanded.
Upstream Tailwind shadcn colors replaced with screen-look custom properties.
Added size 'sm' for list rows; size 'md' keeps the upstream geometry.
Reduced motion swaps state instantly; upstream spring timing is otherwise unchanged.
Added frame 'none': the items are drawn bare (no border, glass or shadow) on whatever holds them, for the message box's bottom row; 'group' keeps the upstream group look.
Added labelDisplay 'tooltip' for constrained toolbars: pinned and keyboard-focused items retain compact geometry; the existing shared hover label also names keyboard focus.
